# Household streaming repository

Before planning or task work in every chat, read root AGENTS.md and perform its mandatory capability discovery. Read the selected instructions and use the exact task and session ID for workflow execution. Missing discovery blocks product work. Do not claim hardware checks or unexecuted tests passed.

Use `docs/development/roadmap.json` as the implementation-status source of truth. For every task, record affected package IDs and expected roadmap impact (or explicitly state none) in the task brief; at closeout update status/evidence or explain why it did not change. Regenerate summaries with `pnpm roadmap:write` and require `pnpm roadmap:check` to pass.
